name: Voxel Shading via Convolution
definition: Voxel shading accounts for variations in embedded directions and scalar attributes, as well as the span of the accumulating cone, by translating these into convolutions of decomposed lobe shapes.
summary: Voxel Shading via Convolution computes indirect illumination by analytically convolving Gaussian lobes representing the BRDF, normal distribution, and view cone, avoiding discrete sampling.
